title: A symmetry-protected pseudo-Hermitian phase of quantum memory-kernel generators
summary: The Jaynes-Cummings (JC) model, introduced in 1963 and central to cavity quantum electrodynamics, describes a two-level system coupled to a single bosonic mode under the rotating-wave approximation. When the mode is projected out via the Nakajima-Zwanzig (NZ) formalism, the memory-kernel generator QLQ is manifestly non-Hermitian -- yet we prove analytically that its spectrum is strictly real at every coupling and every finite truncation, for both vacuum and thermal baths.
